latency_statistic: median of per-trial maxima (3 repairs, 4 ingests, 4 readers per trial); not a production p95 estimate
sql_count_scope: writer apply calls + HTTP read calls + 4 sequential BEGIN/session/owner/COMMIT calls per confirmed transaction; connection handshake excluded; outer driver wrappers reported separately
reader_path: RepositoryState.rows(pr); HTTP/edge and demand overhead excluded
scope: isolated PostgreSQL; identical fixed arrival trace per mode; mocked 50ms upstream; no real GitHub or production writes; includes completion of the same PR obligations; pending fanout enumerated; empty and nonempty histories; latency includes dispatch lag from fixed arrivals; one due poll then fresh checks; not fleet throughput
